Class SimVision

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.vision.SimVision
public class SimVision extends Object
Simulated cameras for every pose source, on PhotonLib's VisionSystemSim.

One PhotonLib vision system holds every AprilTag camera on the robot, the Limelights as well as the Orin's cameras, each with its own mount and camera properties. All of them look at the 2026 field from the simulated truth pose (see Swerve.SimErrors). The Orin cameras are read exactly as on the robot, by PhotonIO over NetworkTables. The Limelights are read by SimVision.LimelightSimIO, which turns the same PhotonLib results into what a Limelight reports:

  • MegaTag1 uses the multi-tag (or single-tag) solve, heading included.
  • MegaTag2 solves translation from each tag with the heading the robot pushed, which is how MegaTag2 works and why it inherits gyro drift.
  • Target size reports the largest target's area, as ta.

The QuestNav is SimVision.QuestSimIO: truth plus a slow random-walk drift, in a field frame that only lines up once the robot has sent a pose reset. Those are the two things a VIO source gets wrong.
